'''Allegiances: Multi-Deck Format''' is a Star Wars CCG constructed format. [[Decipher]] ran it as a four-player side event at [[DecipherCon 1999]]. Decipher's own description of the event is not preserved.<ref name="dc99-thu">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/thu_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule: Thursday], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20021005063305/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/thu_events.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="dc99-fri">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/fri_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule: Friday], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000708001407/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/fri_events.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="dc99-sun">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sun_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule: Sunday], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001026063736/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sun_events.html Internet Archive]</ref>

* '''Type:''' constructed
* '''Defined by:''' Decipher (1999)
* '''Card pool:''' the constructed pool of the host event; four-player tables (Decipher's description is not preserved)
* '''In use:''' 1999 (DecipherCon 1999)
* '''Also called:''' Allegiances Multi Deck Format (Decipher's score sheets)
* '''GEMP:''' none

== History ==
DecipherCon 1999 scheduled Allegiances (event SW.10) on Thursday 11 November from 6 p.m. to 11 p.m.<ref name="dc99-thu">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/thu_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule: Thursday], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20021005063305/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/thu_events.html Internet Archive]</ref> Further heats ran Friday 12 November from 5 p.m. to 10 p.m. and Sunday 14 November from 11 a.m. to 4 p.m.<ref name="dc99-fri">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/fri_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule: Friday], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000708001407/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/fri_events.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="dc99-sun">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sun_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule: Sunday], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001026063736/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sun_events.html Internet Archive]</ref> Two four-player table sheets survive. Results are on [[DecipherCon 1999 Allegiances]].
